zh: This run did not produce the requested reliable new R0. The loadable t1983726 adapter received 1,121 updates / 1,983,726 target tokens, but is not recommended to replace P15 as a broad-task DAPO baseline. On the independent 128-source matched panel, chrF++ rises 47.789→48.797 (delta95%CI[-0.999,2.829]) and BLEU27.172→28.045 (CI also crosses zero), while general chrF++ falls44.431→42.020 beyond the predeclared tolerance. Confirmed G8 coverage rises16/64→17/64, medium6/24→4/24 and long2/24→4/24; greedy confirmed P stays16/64. There are16 uncertain and31 confirmed-all-wrong G8 groups. Even accepting every U yields33/64, below39/64; long4P+7U=11/24 remains below12/24. Failure does not depend on treating uncertainty as error. Hard train-known P improves5/32→12/32 and reference NLL falls, but acquisition remains incomplete. The separate tiny-set model reached30/32, establishing learnability of those sources, not broad generalization or a global capacity ceiling. Candidate capability and incomplete acquisition are evidenced bottlenecks; changing MetricX alone cannot create a correct candidate in31 all-wrong groups. This run makes no DAPO or MetricX calls and cannot causally apportion the preceding DAPO regression. Further SFT must be judged on both acquisition and held-out transfer; more epochs are not a guaranteed remedy.
